cannon.descriptionEn: Builds a cannon of the human magic civilization that shells ground units.

healing_totem.descriptionEn: Places a World Tree healing totem that restores allies in range.

mana_well.descriptionEn: Opens a well pooled with World Tree mana that restores your mana.

tower.descriptionEn: Builds a human anti-air arcane tower that deals area damage to flying units.

towerback.descriptionEn: Summons a MiniRock strapped with a human-made anti-air tower that attacks flying units.

vine_colony.descriptionEn: Plants a vine colony that keeps sending out vines to fend off enemies.

bubble_generator.descriptionEn: Builds a water slime bubble generator that shields allies.

crater.descriptionEn: Leaves a Hellfire Legion ember crater that spits fireballs around it.

electric_tower.descriptionEn: Builds a human arcane lightning tower that fires bouncing bolts.

life_tree.descriptionEn: Plants a World Tree sapling that keeps healing nearby allies.

rock_turret.descriptionEn: Builds a small human siege turret that hurls rocks.

wind_totem.descriptionEn: Places a wind spirit's tailwind totem that blows enemies in a fixed direction.

chicken_commando.descriptionEn: Deploys a paratrooper of the human magic civilization that lands and fights ground enemies.

frenzy_totem.descriptionEn: Drops a Hellfire Legion frenzy totem that makes units in range attack anything, allies included.

leafair.descriptionEn: Sends down leaf fairies that repair allied buildings and extend their duration.

lightning_drop.descriptionEn: Calls down a lightning spirit's thunderbolt onto the target area.

meteor_shower.descriptionEn: Rains hellfire meteors over a wide area.

rock_drop.descriptionEn: Drops a rock golem tribe boulder from the sky.

lightning_explosion.descriptionEn: Detonates a lightning spirit's charge that shocks nearby enemies.

magma_explosion.descriptionEn: Tears open a hellfire magma rift that scorches the area.

overgrowth.descriptionEn: Triggers a World Tree overgrowth that grows small lifeforms larger.

razor_gale.descriptionEn: Spins up a wind spirit's razor gale that keeps cutting enemies in the area.

sand_storm.descriptionEn: Whips up a wind spirit's dust storm that batters enemies in the area.

shock_overload.descriptionEn: Overloads a lightning spirit's charge into a heavy shock and an anti-air blast.

water_explosion.descriptionEn: Erupts a geyser that damages enemies and launches them into the air.

chain_lightning.descriptionEn: Arcs a lightning spirit's bolt that chains between enemies.

fire_shot.descriptionEn: Fires a hellfire projectile in the target direction.

rock_rolling.descriptionEn: Rolls a rock golem tribe boulder that bounces off enemies and walls.

tide_call.descriptionEn: Calls a water slime tide that pushes enemies back and leaves a water trail.

vine_toss.descriptionEn: Erupts a line of World Tree vines that strike enemies in sequence.

will_o_wisp.descriptionEn: Fires a will-o'-wisp of World Tree mana that seizes control of an enemy.

wind_blade.descriptionEn: Launches a crescent wind blade that pierces through enemies.

aqua_archer.descriptionEn: Summons an equipment-wielding water slime archer that attacks ground and flying units from range.

bubble_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a bubble-wielding water slime that attacks flying units with bursting bubbles.

cloud_dragon.descriptionEn: Summons a cloud-scaled wind spirit dragon that dampens the area and attacks enemies.

dimension_toad.descriptionEn: Summons a Boundary Carrier of the dimensional wanderers that alternately opens gates for Cinder Shards and Storm Shards.

ember_spirit_swarm.descriptionEn: Summons a swarm of small ember demons of the Hellfire Legion.

fire_lord_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a Hellfire Legion commander that keeps sending out lesser demons to attack enemies.

fire_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a lesser demon of the Hellfire Legion that burns nearby enemies.

magma_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a magma-crusted demon of the Hellfire Legion that burns enemies.

mini_rock_swarm.descriptionEn: Summons a pair of MiniRock twins of the rock golem tribe.

rock_golem.descriptionEn: Summons a mossy warrior of the rock golem tribe that attacks ground enemies up close.

rock_mage.descriptionEn: Summons a rune-stone shaman of the rock golem tribe that strikes enemies with two rocks.

seed_spirit_swarm.descriptionEn: Summons a swarm of small seed spirits fallen from the World Tree.

storm_rider.descriptionEn: Summons a World Tree wind spirit rider that prioritizes attacking the player.

thunder_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a lightning spirit born at the World Tree that flies fast and attacks enemies.

tornado_strike.descriptionEn: Sends a wind spirit turned tornado sweeping across the field.

tree_golem.descriptionEn: Summons a slow but sturdy World Tree ancient guardian that fights ground enemies.

vine_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a World Tree nature spirit woven from vines that chases down enemies.

water_slime_swarm.descriptionEn: Summons a swarm of surviving water slimes that leave a water field in their wake.

wind_spirit.descriptionEn: Summons a gale wind spirit that rushes at enemies and bursts.

zap_mouse.descriptionEn: Summons a cowardly lightning spirit mouse that loves buildings.

thunder_bird_swarm.descriptionEn: Summons a flock of World Tree thunderbirds that charge at enemies.

evil_ent.descriptionEn: Summons an Evil Ent that punches from range and periodically drags in a light enemy to burn it.

sea_serpent.descriptionEn: Summons a serpent that leaves water fields where it moves and fires a water beam through every enemy in a line.

storm_stag.descriptionEn: Summons a thunder stag that charges and attacks enemies.

wall_golem.descriptionEn: Summons a large, sturdy rock golem that fights only ground enemies.

shock_trap.descriptionEn: Places a trap that arms when an enemy steps in, then stuns the area.

repair_totem.descriptionEn: Places a totem that stops nearby allied buildings from decaying.

grass_generator.descriptionEn: Builds a structure that keeps spreading leaf fields around it.

dragon_tower.descriptionEn: Builds a tower that fires flame shots at both ground and air targets.

firework_tower.descriptionEn: Builds a tower that lobs shells and blows up where they land.

boulder_strike.descriptionEn: Hurls a boulder that knocks its target back and deals extra damage when the target slams into a wall or another enemy.

spirit_bomb.descriptionEn: Drains your own units down to half health and fires a beam that deals 70% of what it took, split over four hits.

titan_remnant.descriptionEn: Summons a titan remnant that remains on the battlefield for a time, periodically erupting a giant stone fist beneath nearby enemies.

tidal_warhead.descriptionEn: Fires a warhead that homes in on the nearest air target, or the nearest ground target when there is none.

bomb_sprite.descriptionEn: Summons a flying sprite that drops bombs on ground targets and blows them up where they land.
